anti_overlap: fd-snorkel-programmatic-labeling covers weak supervision and labeling function design from the comments directly
fd-dual-encoder-editorial covers the embedding architecture for editorial similarity
fd-category-editorial-transforms covers the algebraic/compositional structure of edit operations
decision_lens: Prioritizes findings that offer quantitative models of 'intended departure from baseline' — techniques where deviation from a learned norm is itself the signal, not noise. Especially values work on learned vs. rule-based expressivity.
focus: Music AI expressivity modeling techniques applied to modeling intentional editorial deviation from norms
name: fd-music-expressivity-deviation
persona: A researcher at the intersection of music information retrieval and NLP, specializing in how expressive deviation models (vibrato, rubato, dynamics) transfer to stylistic intentionality detection in text editing. Reads ISMIR, SMC, and ICML proceedings together.
review_areas: Survey 2024-2026 piano/vocal performance expressivity models (e.g., SketchVAE follow-ons, Basis Mixer variants) for latent 'departure magnitude' representations transferable to edit intensity scoring
Identify how music AI separates performer intent from mistake — map this to Ryan's 'know when NOT to edit' signal and the 7K editor comments flagging deliberate author choices
Research groove/microtiming deviation models as analogy for prose rhythm preservation — which embedding schemes capture rhythmic intentionality vs. error
Examine style transfer in symbolic music (e.g., MT3 follow-ons, music LLMs circa 2025) for how 'voice consistency' is operationalized — direct mapping to voice-consistent editing requirement
Find papers on contrastive learning over performance pairs (expressive vs. deadpan) as template for the 23K before/after pair contrastive training setup
Check ISMIR 2024-2025 for annotation schema designs in expressivity datasets — LAF/GrAF-compatible or otherwise — that handle graded, overlapping labels
success_hints: A concrete 'deviation intentionality score' formulation borrowed from music that can be computed over edit pairs without requiring explicit intent labels
At least one 2024-2025 paper whose contrastive pair training architecture maps cleanly onto the 23K before/after corpus structure
task_context: A self-improving editorial AI has 23K before/after editing pairs with 7K editor comments. Phase 2 requires annotation schema design, weak supervision from comments, a defeasible rule hierarchy, and dual-encoder embeddings for editorial similarity.
